mara.activity: Wake, wash, dress in work clothes, and eat a quiet breakfast in the kitchen. I check on Julian afterward without disturbing him for long.
mara.intention: Start the day steadily and make sure Julian has what he needs before I begin work.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea for Julian, carry it to his room, check his temperature, and put painkillers and a water bottle within reach. I return to the kitchen and place my tea bag and brass spoon on the sink-cabinet countertop.
mara.intention: Handle the morning care practically, then prepare my own work tea.

mara.activity: Make coffee, carry it and my laptop to the second bedroom, and settle the printed style sheet and proof pages on the desk. I send Julian a brief message asking him to call if he needs anything.
mara.intention: Set up the workday without making Julian manage household decisions.

mara.activity: Edit the active manuscript at Julian's desk, checking the proof pages against the printed style sheet and recording notes. I pause once to check whether Julian needs more tea or water.
mara.intention: Complete the morning editing block while staying quietly available.

mara.activity: Make a light lunch, carry it to the dining table, and eat while listening to the radio. I rinse the dishes afterward and leave the kitchen reasonably clear.
mara.intention: Take a proper break and eat something uncomplicated.

mara.activity: Make fresh tea for Julian, carry it to his room, check his temperature, and replace the water bottle if needed.
mara.intention: Check on his condition before returning to scheduled work.

mara.activity: Continue editing and take the scheduled client calls. I keep a concise list of follow-up points and save the manuscript before ending the work block.
mara.intention: Keep the normal professional schedule while protecting enough attention for Julian's care.

mara.activity: Save the current work, return the proof pages to the canvas folder, and write tomorrow's short task list. I check on Julian once more before going out.
mara.intention: Close work cleanly and make the evening manageable.

mara.activity: Make a brief grocery run for vegetables and a few easy foods, carrying the canvas tote and keys.
mara.intention: Buy what is needed for a simple dinner and for Julian's recovery without turning it into a full errand.

mara.activity: Put away the groceries, wash my hands, and prepare a simple dinner of toast with melted cheddar and sliced vegetables. I carry Julian's portion and water to him, then eat mine at the dining table.
mara.intention: Take over dinner so Julian does not have to cook or make decisions.

mara.activity: Read or watch a quiet program with Julian, checking discreetly whether he needs water or another blanket. When I finish reading, I leave the book face-down with its receipt marking the page on the small shelving unit by the sofa.
mara.intention: Offer calm company without demanding conversation from him.

mara.activity: Wash up, check Julian's temperature once more, put painkillers and water beside him, and make sure he is settled before leaving him to rest.
mara.intention: Complete the evening care routine and reduce the chance that he has to get up unnecessarily.

mara.activity: Wash my face and brush my teeth, change into sleep clothes, and put my reading glasses on the nightstand by my bed.
mara.intention: Wind down and keep the bedroom ready for sleep.

mara.activity: Put my phone on charge by the wardrobe, read a few pages in bed, and go to sleep.
mara.intention: Rest while keeping the phone out of arm's reach overnight.

julian.activity: Wake slowly, take my temperature, drink some water, and sit on the edge of the bed before deciding not to work or commute.
julian.intention: Check how ill I feel without rushing myself.

julian.activity: Send the museum a brief message saying I am still ill and will remain at home, then silence non-urgent work notifications.
julian.intention: Reduce work guilt and make my absence clear.

julian.activity: Wash, change into comfortable clothes, and leave the used sleep clothes in the hamper rather than attempting my normal full routine.
Make weak tea and eat a small breakfast slowly, carrying it from the kitchen to the living-room sofa.
julian.intention: Get a little food and fluid in me before resting.

julian.activity: Lie on the large sofa and sleep or rest, keeping my phone nearby but not responding to ordinary museum messages.
julian.intention: Recover instead of turning the day into an unproductive workday.

julian.activity: Check my temperature again, take an ordinary dose of medicine after checking the label, and refill my water.
julian.intention: Manage the symptoms sensibly and monitor whether they are changing.

julian.activity: Eat a very small lunch of crackers, cheese, and a little fruit at the kitchen island, then leave the dishes by the sink for later.
julian.intention: Have something bland without spending energy cooking.

julian.activity: Return to the living-room sofa for quiet rest, briefly listening to only essential museum updates if they arrive.
julian.intention: Rest while remaining reachable for a genuine emergency.

julian.activity: Take a lukewarm shower, brush my teeth, and put on fresh comfortable clothes.
julian.intention: Reset after sleeping badly and feeling clammy.

julian.activity: Rest in the second bedroom with the phone on silent, making only a short note of anything the museum can wait for tomorrow.
julian.intention: Keep work contained and try to sleep again.

julian.activity: Order a simple dinner and drinks from my phone rather than cooking, then clear a small space at the dining table.
julian.intention: Arrange an easy meal while Mara is out or occupied, without asking her to care for me.

julian.activity: Collect the delivered food, carry it to the dining table, and eat a small portion slowly.
julian.intention: Eat enough to support recovery without forcing a full meal.

julian.activity: Put the remaining food into a container and leave the used plate and fork by the sink, then return to the sofa.
julian.intention: Do the minimum clearing-up before resting again.

julian.activity: Watch something quiet or doze on the large sofa, keeping conversation minimal and asking for help only if I need it.
Wash my face, brush my teeth, drink some water, and check my temperature once more.
julian.intention: Prepare for bed and notice any worsening symptoms.

julian.activity: Get into bed, silence work notifications completely, and leave the phone on the nightstand rather than answering messages.
julian.intention: Give myself the best chance of sleeping and recovering.

julian.activity: Rest quietly and try to sleep, keeping water within reach.
julian.intention: End the day focused on recovery rather than work.
